task.title: Build private Sunday decision packet review deck
task.body:
Parent: t_b14c27d5. Start after QMD refresh evidence exists.

Objective:
- Build a private/local, self-contained HTML review deck or printable command-center artifact from `/Users/jeff/Documents/Codex/2026-05-05/i-want-to-install-hermes-agent/whiteford-ai-law-pages/docs/digests/2026-05-10_sunday_morning_decision_packet.md` and `/Users/jeff/Documents/Codex/2026-05-05/i-want-to-install-hermes-agent/whiteford-ai-law-pages/docs/reviews/2026-05-10_sunday_morning_decision_packet_rereview.md`.
- Use the Claude/design posture for a high-clarity internal artifact: one-screen executive summary, five decision boxes, hard no-external-action wall, blocker lineage for `t_fa6eb9c1` and `t_53d470c6`, and links to the QMD refresh/command-center evidence.
- Keep it static/local only. Do not add forms, approval capture, API calls, live integrations, publishing/deployment, or production credentials.

Business-development principle to preserve: deliver narrow diagnostic value first, make the buyer problem-aware, earn engaged time/trust before any consultation ask, and keep all follow-up opt-in-only; Whiteford/Schell IP legal copy must remain educational, non-hypey, non-confidential, attorney-review-gated, and no-ACR/no-legal-advice.

Deliverables expected:
- Create `/Users/jeff/Documents/Codex/2026-05-05/i-want-to-install-hermes-agent/whiteford-ai-law-pages/docs/digests/2026-05-10_sunday_decision_packet_review_deck.html` (self-contained HTML/CSS/JS only if needed).
- If useful, add a brief implementation note next to it; otherwise the HTML can include an internal notes section.
- Update `/Users/jeff/Documents/Codex/2026-05-05/i-want-to-install-hermes-agent/whiteford-ai-law-pages/docs/KANBAN_DELIVERABLE_INDEX.md`.
- Leave the standard Kanban deliverable comment.

Acceptance criteria:
- The artifact is readable locally, print-friendly, and explicitly says it is not an approval record and authorizes no external/live-system action.
- It accurately preserves the Sunday packet's recommendation: only Tech GC local/no-token QA is an optional Jeff-approved lane; Supabase/source/HighLevel/authority/public actions remain held.
- Verify file existence and run deterministic HTML/static checks; browser/screenshot verification is welcome if available.
- No external/public action, no CRM/HighLevel mutation, no Supabase DDL/sync/backfill/row mutation, no Clio, no email/social/LinkedIn/ad action.
